target.title: feat(whatsapp): add requester-bound MeowCaller calls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp-connected agents cannot place a WhatsApp voice call back to the person who triggered a turn. This adds an experimental, requester-bound call tool for audible task-completion or urgent notifications.

Closes #99634

## Why This Change Was Made

The WhatsApp plugin registers `whatsapp_call` only for WhatsApp-originated turns carrying trusted requester context. The tool accepts a message but no destination, resolves the requester from inbound identity, synthesizes telephony TTS, and invokes a separately paired MeowCaller companion with fixed `notify` arguments.

The companion contract is explicit and send-only: the reviewed [MeowCaller PR #7](https://github.com/purpshell/meowcaller/pull/7) adds `pair` and `notify`, and `notify` exits successfully only after answer, playback, and hangup. OpenClaw pins the reviewed MeowCaller commit in its setup documentation and keeps the companion's linked-device credentials separate from the normal WhatsApp channel session.

## User Impact

After installing the pinned MeowCaller CLI, pairing its separate linked-device session, and configuring TTS, a user can message: `Call me and say the build finished.`

Boundaries:

- calls only the current WhatsApp requester; there is no destination argument
- rejects self-calls and concurrent calls for one account
- supports PCM and mu-law telephony TTS outputs
- limits synthesized audio to 60 seconds
- deletes private temporary audio after each attempt
- uses explicit store, answer-timeout, and max-duration arguments
- reports success only when MeowCaller exits with code 0 after playback and hangup
- emits POSIX or PowerShell pairing instructions for the current platform
- budgets the full companion lifecycle: 60-second connect wait, 45-second answer timeout, audio playback, and shutdown grace (115-175 seconds total)

No new OpenClaw config or environment variables.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/whatsapp/src/agent-tools-call.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/index.test.ts` — 11/11 passed
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwnkdw7yp8gj5n63d61x7zxd` — changed checks, typecheck, lint, and guards passed
- Same Testbox — WhatsApp extension suite passed: 86 files and 998/998 tests
- [Testbox Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28693818024)
- MeowCaller: `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go build -o /tmp/meowcaller-notify ./cmd/meowcaller` passed
- Autoreview accepted and drove fixes for the explicit CLI contract, mu-law conversion, safe setup commands, cross-platform store DSNs, and the complete process timeout budget. Final focused review found no actionable defects.
- Upstream implementation: [purpshell/meowcaller#7](https://github.com/purpshell/meowcaller/pull/7)

Live call proof is the only remaining item. The first interactive QR window expired without a scan, so no linked-device credentials were created. A fresh QR scan and an approved recipient number in E.164 form are required before placing the call; this PR remains draft until that proof is recorded.
